Feature-film CG character. Non-photographic digital character render; an authored digital production character. All following identity, surface and presentation choices belong to this medium.

Digital sculptural form: sculpted facial planes organize the authored face, jaw and brow; shoulder and torso planes articulate the specified anatomy. Preserve ordinary adult proportions when authored; refine volume transitions without imposing a universal heroic body.

Digital sculptural construction with authored facial plane organization; preserve the specified anatomy and age exactly: 三十岁上下

Authored digital sculptural anatomy: 胸廓深而髋部稳，肩宽腰收但腹部保持能承压的体块

Authored digital sculptural anatomy: 依上述骨架保留能承重的肉量，不按性格自动加肌肉。

Authored digital sculptural anatomy: 以上述具体体块关系辨识，不指定无来源测量数值。

Authored digital sculptural anatomy: 偏长方脸，颧面转折宽，颊部不削成尖锐骨片

Authored digital sculptural anatomy: 下颌宽而下巴不前突

Authored digital sculptural anatomy: 眼裂略深、眼尾平；静止时可清楚看见观察目标转换

Authored digital sculptural anatomy: 眉量足、走势近直，内段略不齐

Authored digital sculptural anatomy: 鼻梁坚实而鼻头略宽

Cinematic digital skin shading: controlled subsurface response, authored skin roughness and sculpted pore detail; deliberate highlight response follows facial planes. Keep skin supple and varied; avoid plastic, wax or figurine surfaces.

CG skin: authored skin-tone variation and digitally sculpted surface detail, controlled CG skin roughness and designed subsurface response; preserve the specified irregularity: 户外肤色不均；保留鼻侧和颧部表面纹理起伏

Digitally groomed hair and beard, including natural stubble when specified: controlled strand grouping and authored groom silhouette preserve the authored hair length and beard density. Do not add hair or beard absent from character facts.

Digital groom: authored strand grouping and controlled groom silhouette; preserve the specified growth, length and density: 发向后收束，发际两侧略不齐

Authored digital groom structure: 上唇短须与颌缘较密短须连贯，非飘逸长髯

Authored CG material treatment: controlled surface roughness, sculpted fold hierarchy, designed edge wear and deliberate material separation. Cloth, leather and metal retain their physical responses wherever present; preserve historically credible construction and functional joints.

CG materials: authored material separation, controlled roughness hierarchy, digitally sculpted cloth folds, designed leather response and CG metal surface treatment wherever those materials are specified; preserve historical construction: 楚军领兵者旧甲

Authored CG material construction: 项羽通过服装整体较完整、腰部组织清楚且个人体量可辨，非巨大金冠与飘带。

Authored CG material construction: 交领与裹束关系服从本轮时代边界；袖口不过手掌，衣摆分量允许跨步与屈髋。绳带末端短收，不飘入手与缰。

Authored CG material construction: 胸腹小片叠接，肩肘保留活动区；腰下甲裙分片随腿移动。没有后世巨大护肩、机械关节或无缝金属紧身衣。

Authored CG material construction: 麻织底层；较密织外层；皮革系带；哑暗铁质小片甲，构造为受约束设计提案，非精确考古复原

Authored CG material construction: 贴身层→工作承力衣→外衣→短甲片层；手掌与手指保持可接触缰/剑。

Authored CG material construction: 高频接触的袖口、腰缘、膝部先磨；磨痕并非全身均匀噪声。

Shape design: silhouette hierarchy, facial plane emphasis, proportion refinement and mass distribution make the authored geometry readable. Preserve exact authored anatomical relationships; do not invent larger shoulders, armor or weapons.

CG shape design: designed silhouette and controlled proportion refinement express the specified contour without changing body dimensions: 主躯干压住空间，头部转动仍先于全身

Feature-film CG character presentation: cinematic digital character rendering with physically grounded CG lighting; a digital production character whose authored surfaces, groom and sculptural volumes remain visible under the specified composition.

Feature-film CG look-development presentation with physically grounded digital lighting; implement this composition and performance intent as a digital character design presentation: 仅一个人物，三分之四朝向，头顶至大腿中段构图；脸、双肩、胸廓、腰髋和手清晰可读。简洁无叙事背景，无其他人物、无马、无场景图、无字。稳定站立，注意在画外具体方向；停顿是判路而非摆威吓姿态。基础旧甲无新增伤血。不得用王冠、永久怒目、肥胖圆脸、少年纤弱比例或额外道具代替身体与面部辨识。

HEROIC treatment: emphasize authored proportion, silhouette and character-specific screen presence through readable face-to-body hierarchy, without changing authored mass. Stay within the medium and realism limits; invent no rank, weapon, fixed expression or body type.

GROUNDED_STYLIZED realism: retain human anatomy, weight and historically credible equipment while refining authored forms, silhouette and material hierarchy. Permit controlled emphasis within plausible joint mechanics; non-cartoon, non-anime, without exaggerated game-cutscene anatomy.

DESIGN_NEUTRAL: neutral treatment within feature-film CG look-development presentation; authored digital volumes remain legible without extra hero staging.

CG production character boundary; retain this source constraint: 不复制明星或既有影像角色；不把设计当作历史写真；不以永久怒目、完美对称面孔代替观察和反应；不加入超自然肌体或眼部发光
